name: Mizari
source:
A cleric with a rather unfortunate name.

Travelling alongside her childhood friend, Nerui, and a warrior who sees their potential named Merrick, she becomes a mercenary.

She's a bleeding heart who can never turn a blind eye from an injured person.

[From [url=https://reineworks.itch.io/mizari-loves-company]itch.io[/url]]
